disclaimer: General fitness guidance only, not medical advice. Consult a qualified professional before starting a new training programme.

workouts.name: Threshold kilometres
workouts.purpose: Raise the pace you can hold before lactate climbs — the engine behind every race run.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, then 4 × 20 s strides with walk back.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 5 × 1 km at threshold (comfortably hard, could speak in short phrases), 90 s jog recovery between reps.

workouts.name: Four hundreds at 5k pace
workouts.purpose: Sharpen leg speed so race pace feels like cruising.
workouts.warmup: 12 min easy, drills: A-skips, high knees, heel flicks.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 8 × 400 m at current 5 km pace, 60 s standing recovery.

workouts.name: Continuous tempo
workouts.purpose: Hold one honest effort without the mental break of intervals.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 25 min continuous at race effort. Even pace throughout — check your split every 5 min and correct early.

workouts.name: Long run with pickups
workouts.purpose: Aerobic base with a reminder of what pace feels like on tired legs.
workouts.warmup: Start easy, no separate warm-up needed.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 75 min easy zone 2. From minute 40, insert 4 × 2 min at race pace with 5 min easy between.

workouts.name: Pyramid intervals
workouts.purpose: Practise changing gear, which is what happens every time you leave a station.
workouts.warmup: 12 min easy plus strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 1-2-3-2-1 min hard with equal jog recovery. Repeat the ladder twice, 3 min easy between ladders.

scaling.up: Three ladders, recovery cut to half the work time.

workouts.name: Hill repeats
workouts.purpose: Build running strength with less impact than flat speed work.
workouts.warmup: 15 min easy to the hill, 3 × 15 s build-ups.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 10 × 45 s uphill hard, jog down as recovery. Stay tall, drive the knee, short quick steps.

scaling.up: 14 repeats, or use a 6% treadmill incline.

workouts.name: Progression run
workouts.purpose: Teach yourself to finish faster than you start.
workouts.warmup: Built into the run.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 40 min: 15 min easy, 15 min steady, 10 min at race pace. No stopping between blocks.

scaling.up: 55 min, finish the last 5 min faster than race pace.

workouts.name: Eight hundreds at 10k pace
workouts.purpose: Sit at the edge of hard for longer than a 400 lets you.
workouts.warmup: 12 min easy plus 4 strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 6 × 800 m at 10 km pace, 2 min jog recovery. Same split for the last rep as the first.

workouts.name: Fartlek on feel
workouts.purpose: Unstructured speed when you don't want a watch dictating the session.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 10 × (2 min hard / 1 min easy), run on terrain and feel rather than pace.

workouts.name: Race pace continuous
workouts.purpose: Rehearse the exact pace you'll hold on race day, with no stations to hide behind.
workouts.warmup: 12 min easy building to steady.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 6 km continuous at target race run pace. If it falls apart after 4 km, your race target is optimistic.

workouts.name: Treadmill incline intervals
workouts.purpose: Strength-biased running for bad weather or dark evenings.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy on flat.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 8 × 90 s at 5% incline, hard effort, 90 s walk at 0% between.

workouts.name: Broken threshold
workouts.purpose: Get threshold volume in without the neural cost of one long grind.
workouts.warmup: 12 min easy plus strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 3 sets of 4 × 400 m at threshold, 30 s standing rest between reps, 2 min between sets.

workouts.name: Recovery jog
workouts.purpose: Move blood through tired legs without adding fatigue.
workouts.warmup: None — the whole run is easy.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 30 min zone 1 to low zone 2. Nose breathing throughout. If you can't hold a conversation, slow down.

workouts.name: 5 km time trial
workouts.purpose: A hard number to set training paces from. Repeat every 6–8 weeks.
workouts.warmup: 15 min easy, drills, 4 × 20 s strides.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 5 km flat, hardest sustainable effort. Go out on target pace, not on feel — the first kilometre always feels easy.

workouts.name: Long reps at half-marathon effort
workouts.purpose: Aerobic strength that holds up across eight race runs, not just one.
workouts.warmup: 12 min easy.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 3 × 2 km at half-marathon effort, 3 min jog recovery.

workouts.name: Wall ball run rounds
workouts.purpose: The classic pattern: run, lose your legs to squats, run again anyway.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, 20 air squats, 10 empty wall balls.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 4 rounds: 1 km run at race pace + 25 wall balls at race weight. Walk 60 s between rounds.

workouts.cooldown: 5 min walk, quad and hip stretch.

scaling.up: 5 rounds of 1 km + 35 wall balls, no rest between rounds.

workouts.name: Ski and run repeats
workouts.purpose: Teach your legs to run after your arms and lungs have taken a beating.
workouts.warmup: 500 m easy ski, 10 min easy jog.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 5 rounds: 500 m SkiErg hard + 1 km run at race pace. Start running within 15 s of dropping the handles.

scaling.down: 3 rounds of 400 m ski + 800 m run.
scaling.up: 6 rounds, hold the same run split throughout.

workouts.name: Sled sandwich
workouts.purpose: The hardest legs-out-of-legs combination in the race, drilled in isolation.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, 2 × 25 m light sled push.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 3 rounds: 1 km run + 50 m sled push at race weight + 50 m sled pull + 1 km run. Rest 3 min between rounds.

scaling.down: 2 rounds at 60% race sled weight, 800 m runs.

workouts.name: Row and run ladder
workouts.purpose: Descending distances so pace has to climb as fatigue does.
workouts.warmup: 500 m easy row, 8 min easy jog.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 1000 m row + 1 km run, then 750 m row + 800 m run, then 500 m row + 600 m run, then 250 m row + 400 m run. No rest — transitions are the session.

scaling.down: Start at 750 m row and 800 m run.
scaling.up: Run the ladder up and back down.

workouts.name: Burpee broad jump intervals
workouts.purpose: The station that wrecks most people's fourth run. Practise running off it.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, 10 slow burpees, hip openers.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 5 rounds: 20 m burpee broad jumps + 600 m run at race pace. 90 s rest between rounds.

workouts.cooldown: 8 min easy jog, hip flexor stretch.

scaling.down: 4 rounds of 15 m + 400 m, step-back burpees.

workouts.name: Farmers carry shuttles and runs
workouts.purpose: Grip and trunk fatigue changes your running form. Find out how much.
workouts.warmup: 8 min easy jog, 2 × 25 m light carry.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 4 rounds: 100 m farmers carry at race weight (break only if grip fails) + 800 m run. 60 s rest between rounds.

workouts.cooldown: Forearm and lat stretch, 5 min walk.

scaling.down: 4 rounds of 50 m carry at 70% weight + 600 m run.
scaling.up: 5 rounds of 200 m carry + 1 km run.

workouts.name: Lunge and run
workouts.purpose: Station seven into run eight is where races are lost. Rehearse it fresh-ish.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, 20 bodyweight walking lunges.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 4 rounds: 50 m sandbag lunges at race weight + 800 m run. Rest 2 min between rounds.

scaling.down: 3 rounds of 25 m lunges at half weight + 600 m run.
scaling.up: 5 rounds of 100 m lunges + 1 km run.

workouts.name: Descending ski and run
workouts.purpose: Negative-split practice with shrinking work and no extra rest.
workouts.warmup: 400 m ski easy, 8 min easy jog.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 1000 m ski + 1 km run, 750 m ski + 750 m run, 500 m ski + 500 m run, 250 m ski + 250 m run. Every run split faster than the last.

scaling.up: Add a 1250 m ski and 1250 m run at the top.

workouts.name: Four station mini sim
workouts.purpose: Half the race pattern at full race intensity, without a full sim's recovery cost.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, light reps on each station.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 1 km run + 1000 m ski, 1 km run + 50 m sled push, 1 km run + 1000 m row, 1 km run + 50 wall balls. Race standard weights, no rest.

scaling.down: Halve the station volumes, keep the runs.
scaling.up: Add a fifth round: 1 km run + 100 m farmers carry.

workouts.name: Transition drill
workouts.purpose: The first 200 m off a station is where most time leaks. Train that specific moment.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 8 rounds: 30 s hard on a station (alternate ski and wall balls) then immediately 400 m run at race pace. 60 s walk between rounds. Focus entirely on turnover in the first 50 m.

workouts.name: Wall ball pyramid with runs
workouts.purpose: Build the squat endurance that makes the last station survivable.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, 15 air squats, 10 light wall balls.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 10, 20, 30, 20, 10 wall balls at race weight, with a 600 m run at race pace after each set. No rest beyond the transitions.

workouts.name: Heavy sled, fast run
workouts.purpose: Deliberate mismatch: maximum leg load then maximum turnover.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, 3 × 15 m building sled push.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 6 rounds: 25 m sled push at 120% of race weight + 400 m run faster than race pace. 2 min rest between rounds.

workouts.name: Row thousands
workouts.purpose: Straight race-distance practice for the two erg stations and the runs around them.
workouts.warmup: 500 m easy row, 10 min easy jog.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 3 rounds: 1000 m row at race pace + 1 km run at race pace. 90 s rest between rounds. Log every split.

workouts.name: Roxzone rush
workouts.purpose: Train the walking-and-recovering bit between run and station, which is untrained time for nearly everyone.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, light station reps.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 6 rounds: 600 m run, then a forced 20 s walk-in, then 60 s max effort on a rotating station (ski, row, wall balls). Start the next run immediately. Practise breathing down in that 20 s.

workouts.name: Double run blocks
workouts.purpose: Longer running exposure than a sim gives you, with stations still in the way.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, light sled and sandbag reps.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 2 km run + 50 m sled pull + 2 km run + 50 m sandbag lunges + 2 km run. Race weights, rest only as long as a transition takes.

scaling.up: 3 km runs, add a third station.

workouts.name: Squat strength
workouts.purpose: Raw leg strength makes every sled metre and every wall ball cheaper.
workouts.warmup: 5 min bike or row, 20 air squats, 2 empty bar sets, build to working weight.

blocks.name: Main lift
blocks.detail: Back squat 5 × 5 at roughly 80% of your best single. 3 min rest between sets.

blocks.name: Accessory
blocks.detail: Romanian deadlift 3 × 8. Walking lunge 3 × 20 m with dumbbells. Hanging knee raise 3 × 12.

workouts.cooldown: Hip flexor and adductor stretch, 5 min.

scaling.up: Add a top single before the 5 × 5.

workouts.name: Leg volume
workouts.purpose: Muscle in the quads and glutes — the tissue that absorbs race-day damage.
workouts.warmup: 5 min easy row, banded glute work, 2 build-up sets.

blocks.name: Main
blocks.detail: Front squat 4 × 8 at a weight you could do 10 with. 2 min rest.

blocks.name: Superset
blocks.detail: Bulgarian split squat 3 × 10 each leg with dumbbells, straight into leg curl or Nordic 3 × 8.

blocks.name: Finisher
blocks.detail: Goblet squat 2 × 20, controlled tempo.

scaling.down: Drop the finisher, use bodyweight split squats.

workouts.name: Posterior chain
workouts.purpose: Hamstrings, glutes and back — the sled pull and the last two kilometres.
workouts.warmup: 5 min row, 10 good mornings with empty bar, banded hamstring work.

blocks.name: Main lift
blocks.detail: Deadlift 4 × 5, stopping each set with two reps left in the tank. 3 min rest.

blocks.name: Accessory
blocks.detail: Hip thrust 3 × 10. Single-leg RDL 3 × 10 each. Back extension 3 × 15.

scaling.down: Trap bar deadlift or kettlebell deadlift 4 × 8.

workouts.name: Pull and carry
workouts.purpose: Back and grip strength for the sled pull, farmers carry and ski.
workouts.warmup: Band pull-aparts, scap pull-ups, 5 min easy erg.

blocks.name: Main
blocks.detail: Pull-ups 5 × 6-8, weighted if you can. 2 min rest.

blocks.name: Accessory
blocks.detail: Bent-over row 4 × 8. Single-arm dumbbell row 3 × 10 each. Face pulls 3 × 15.

blocks.name: Carry
blocks.detail: Farmers carry 4 × 50 m heavy, rest as needed. Grip should be the limit, not your legs.

scaling.up: Weighted pull-ups 5 × 5, carries at 1.5 × bodyweight total.

workouts.name: Press and stability
workouts.purpose: Overhead strength for the ski and wall ball, and shoulders that survive the volume.
workouts.warmup: Band work, 10 empty bar presses, 5 min easy.

blocks.name: Main
blocks.detail: Strict overhead press 4 × 6. 2 min rest.

blocks.name: Accessory
blocks.detail: Incline dumbbell press 3 × 10. Lateral raise 3 × 15. Overhead carry 3 × 30 m.

blocks.name: Core
blocks.detail: Dead bug 3 × 10 each side, plank 3 × 45 s.

workouts.cooldown: Thoracic opener over a foam roller.

scaling.up: Push press 5 × 3 heavy before the strict work.

workouts.name: Full body basics
workouts.purpose: One session a week that covers everything, for when time is short.
workouts.warmup: 5 min row, dynamic mobility, empty bar work.

blocks.name: Main
blocks.detail: Back squat 4 × 6, deadlift 3 × 5, alternating with 2 min rest.

blocks.name: Upper
blocks.detail: Pull-ups 3 × 8. Overhead press 3 × 8.

blocks.name: Finisher
blocks.detail: Walking lunge 3 × 20 m loaded.

scaling.down: Cut to squat, pull-up and press.
scaling.up: Add sled push 4 × 25 m at the end.

workouts.name: Single leg focus
workouts.purpose: Running and lunging are one-legged. Train them that way and fix side-to-side gaps.
workouts.warmup: Glute activation, 10 step-ups each leg.

blocks.name: Main
blocks.detail: Rear-foot elevated split squat 4 × 8 each leg, heavy dumbbells. 90 s rest.

blocks.name: Accessory
blocks.detail: Step-ups to a knee-height box 3 × 10 each. Single-leg RDL 3 × 10 each. Lateral lunge 3 × 8 each.

blocks.name: Balance
blocks.detail: Single-leg calf raise 3 × 15 each.

scaling.up: Add a weighted vest and a 3 s lowering tempo.

workouts.name: Sled strength
workouts.purpose: Make race sled weight feel light by training well above it.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, 3 × 15 m building pushes.

blocks.name: Push
blocks.detail: 6 × 20 m at 130–150% of race weight. Full recovery, 2-3 min. Quality over grind.

blocks.name: Pull
blocks.detail: 6 × 20 m at 130% race weight, hand over hand. 2 min rest.

blocks.name: Accessory
blocks.detail: Heavy walking lunge 3 × 20 m.

scaling.up: Add 4 × 15 m at maximum movable weight.

workouts.name: Grip and forearms
workouts.purpose: Grip is the limiter on carries and the sled pull for most people, and it's trainable fast.
workouts.warmup: Wrist circles, band extensions, easy hangs.

blocks.name: Hangs
blocks.detail: 4 × max hold from the bar, 90 s rest. Log the times.

blocks.name: Carries
blocks.detail: 5 × 40 m farmers carry, heavy, resting 60 s. Then 3 × 30 m suitcase carry each side.

blocks.name: Finisher
blocks.detail: Plate pinch hold 3 × 30 s each hand. Wrist curls 3 × 15.

workouts.name: Lunge endurance
workouts.purpose: Build tolerance for 100 metres of loaded lunging when your legs are already gone.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, 20 bodyweight lunges, hip openers.

blocks.name: Main
blocks.detail: 5 × 40 m sandbag lunges at race weight, 2 min rest. Knee to the floor every rep, as the standard requires.

blocks.name: Accessory
blocks.detail: Reverse lunge 3 × 12 each leg with dumbbells. Wall sit 3 × 45 s.

workouts.cooldown: Quad and hip flexor stretch, 5 min.

scaling.up: 4 × 75 m, or add a weighted vest.

workouts.name: Trunk and anti-rotation
workouts.purpose: A trunk that doesn't fold under load keeps your running form intact late on.
workouts.warmup: Cat-cow, dead bug, bird dog, 3 min.

blocks.name: Circuit
blocks.detail: 4 rounds, 60 s rest between: 12 kettlebell suitcase deadlifts each side, 30 s side plank each side, 10 Pallof press each side, 15 hollow rocks.

blocks.name: Finisher
blocks.detail: 90 s hollow hold, broken as needed.

scaling.up: 5 rounds, add weight to the planks.

workouts.name: Power and jumps
workouts.purpose: Explosiveness for burpee broad jumps and quicker ground contact when running.
workouts.warmup: Skips, pogo hops, 10 min easy.

blocks.name: Jumps
blocks.detail: 5 × 3 box jumps, stepping down each rep. Then 4 × 4 broad jumps for maximum distance, full rest.

blocks.name: Lift
blocks.detail: Hang power clean 5 × 3, or kettlebell swing 5 × 10 heavy.

blocks.name: Accessory
blocks.detail: Split squat jump 3 × 6 each leg.

scaling.down: Step-ups and low box jumps, swap cleans for swings.

workouts.name: Dumbbell only
workouts.purpose: A full-body session for a hotel gym or a garage with one rack of dumbbells.
workouts.warmup: 5 min skipping or jogging on the spot, mobility.

blocks.name: Circuit
blocks.detail: 4 rounds, 90 s rest: 10 goblet squats, 10 single-arm rows each side, 10 Romanian deadlifts, 10 push presses, 20 m walking lunge.

blocks.name: Finisher
blocks.detail: 3 × 30 s farmers hold with the heaviest pair available.

scaling.up: 5 rounds, add a 400 m run between rounds.

workouts.name: Kettlebell complex
workouts.purpose: Strength with a heart rate cost — useful when you can't fit separate sessions in.
workouts.warmup: Halos, hip hinges, 20 light swings.

blocks.name: Complex
blocks.detail: 5 rounds, no rest inside a round, 2 min between: 10 swings, 8 cleans each side, 6 front squats, 4 push presses each side, 40 m rack carry.

workouts.name: Strength endurance circuit
workouts.purpose: Heavy-ish weights at high reps — the exact quality the back half of a race asks for.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy row, empty bar work.

blocks.name: Circuit
blocks.detail: 4 rounds, 2 min rest between rounds: 15 back squats at 40% of your best single, 15 wall balls, 12 barbell rows, 10 pull-ups, 20 m walking lunge.

workouts.name: SkiErg intervals
workouts.purpose: Find and hold a 1000 m ski pace that doesn't blow the run that follows.
workouts.warmup: 500 m easy ski, 10 × 10 stroke build-ups.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 8 × 250 m at target race pace or faster, 60 s rest. Same split every rep — if rep 8 is slower, rep 1 was too fast.

blocks.name: Technique
blocks.detail: 2 × 200 m at half stroke rate, focusing on full hip hinge and a long finish.

workouts.name: Row five hundreds
workouts.purpose: Race-pace rowing with enough volume to make the pace automatic.
workouts.warmup: 500 m easy row, drills: legs only, legs and body, full stroke.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 6 × 500 m at target 1000 m race pace, 90 s rest. Hold stroke rate between 24 and 28.

blocks.name: Finisher
blocks.detail: 1 × 500 m all out. Log the split.

workouts.name: Wall ball volume
workouts.purpose: Get 100 unbroken reps within reach by training in big chunks.
workouts.warmup: 20 air squats, 15 light wall balls, ankle mobility.

blocks.name: Sets
blocks.detail: 5 × 25 wall balls at race weight, 90 s rest. Every rep to full depth and to the target line.

blocks.name: Skill
blocks.detail: 3 × 10 slow-tempo reps, catching in the squat rather than standing up first.

workouts.name: Burpee broad jump pacing
workouts.purpose: Find a rhythm you can hold for 80 m instead of sprinting 20 m and dying.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, 10 slow burpees, hip openers.

blocks.name: Pacing sets
blocks.detail: 4 × 20 m at a rhythm you could hold for 80 m, 90 s rest. Time each. Target: identical times.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.detail: 1 × 40 m for time. Compare against double your 20 m split.

workouts.name: Sled push technique
workouts.purpose: Body angle and step length decide sled speed far more than leg strength does.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, 3 × 15 m light pushes.

blocks.name: Technique
blocks.detail: 4 × 25 m light: low body angle, arms locked, short choppy steps, eyes down. Film one rep.

blocks.name: Race weight
blocks.detail: 5 × 25 m at race weight, 90 s rest. No stopping mid-length.

blocks.name: Overload
blocks.detail: 3 × 15 m at 120% race weight.

scaling.down: Technique work at 50% race weight only.
scaling.up: 6 × 50 m at race weight, 2 min rest.

workouts.name: Sled pull technique
workouts.purpose: Hand over hand, feet planted, back braced — and knowing when to walk it back.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, band rows, light pull reps.

blocks.name: Technique
blocks.detail: 4 × 12.5 m light, seated-back position, long hand-over-hand pulls, resetting the rope cleanly.

blocks.name: Race weight
blocks.detail: 5 × 25 m at race weight, 2 min rest. Practise the turn and the walk back to the rope.

blocks.name: Grip
blocks.detail: 3 × 30 s heavy hold on the rope.

workouts.cooldown: Lat, forearm and lower back stretch.

workouts.name: Carry and grip block
workouts.purpose: 200 m of farmers carry with no drops. Grip endurance, not grip strength.
workouts.warmup: Wrist and forearm prep, 2 × 25 m light carry.

blocks.name: Main
blocks.detail: 4 × 100 m at race weight, 2 min rest. Count drops — the goal is zero by the end of the block.

blocks.name: Overload
blocks.detail: 2 × 50 m at 120% race weight.

blocks.name: Finisher
blocks.detail: 3 × max hang from a bar.

workouts.name: Sandbag lunge block
workouts.purpose: Bag position and breathing rhythm under a load that makes both hard.
workouts.warmup: 20 bodyweight lunges, hip openers, 2 × 20 m light bag carry.

blocks.name: Technique
blocks.detail: 3 × 20 m at race weight, alternating bag position front rack and back. Find which holds up longer for you.

blocks.name: Volume
blocks.detail: 4 × 25 m at race weight, 90 s rest. Knee touches the floor every rep.

workouts.cooldown: Quad, hip flexor and adductor stretch.

workouts.name: Ski and row couplet
workouts.purpose: Both ergs back to back, which is more upper-body fatigue than either alone.
workouts.warmup: 300 m easy on each machine.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 4 rounds: 500 m ski + 500 m row at race pace, 2 min rest between rounds. Transition in under 15 s.

workouts.cooldown: 400 m easy row, lat and shoulder stretch.

workouts.name: Station benchmark test
workouts.purpose: One hard effort at every station so you know your real splits, not your hoped-for ones.
workouts.warmup: 15 min: easy jog, light reps at each station.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.detail: Each station once at race standard, for time, with 4 min rest between: 1000 m ski, 50 m sled push, 50 m sled pull, 80 m burpee broad jumps, 1000 m row, 200 m farmers carry, 100 m lunges, 100 wall balls.

scaling.down: Test four stations, the four you're weakest at.

workouts.name: Wall ball ladder
workouts.purpose: Train the ability to go unbroken deep into a set, not just to accumulate reps.
workouts.warmup: 20 air squats, 15 light reps.

blocks.name: Ladder
blocks.detail: 10, 15, 20, 25, 20, 15, 10 unbroken at race weight. Rest equal to the reps just done in seconds. Any break means repeat that rung once.

workouts.name: Erg pacing test
workouts.purpose: Two honest race-distance efforts to set your erg target paces from.
workouts.warmup: 500 m easy on each, build-ups.

blocks.name: Test
blocks.detail: 1000 m SkiErg for time. Rest 8 min. 1000 m row for time. Record split, stroke rate and how the last 250 m felt.

scaling.up: Add a 500 m all-out on each after 5 min rest.

workouts.name: Sled doubles
workouts.purpose: Push and pull back to back, the way the race gives it to you.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, light sled work both directions.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 5 rounds: 25 m push + 25 m pull at race weight, 2 min rest. Keep the transition tight — walk to the rope with purpose.

blocks.name: Finisher
blocks.detail: 2 rounds at 110% race weight, full rest.

workouts.cooldown: 10 min walk, calf and lat stretch.

scaling.up: 6 rounds of 50 m each, 90 s rest.

workouts.name: Quad pre-fatigue block
workouts.purpose: The last two stations come after everything else. Train them already tired.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, 20 air squats, light reps.

blocks.name: Pre-fatigue
blocks.detail: 3 min of air squats and wall sits, continuous.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 3 rounds: 25 m sandbag lunges + 25 wall balls at race weight, 2 min rest.

workouts.cooldown: Quad and hip flexor stretch, 10 min walk.

scaling.up: 4 rounds, 50 m lunges and 35 wall balls.

workouts.name: Burpee and ski combo
workouts.purpose: Upper body under fatigue, with the breathing pattern that makes the ski feel worse than it is.
workouts.warmup: 400 m easy ski, 10 slow burpees.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 5 rounds: 15 m burpee broad jumps + 250 m ski hard, 90 s rest. Keep the ski split steady across all five.

workouts.cooldown: 400 m easy ski, chest and shoulder stretch.

scaling.up: 6 rounds, 20 m and 300 m, 60 s rest.

workouts.name: Thirty thirties
workouts.purpose: Classic aerobic power intervals — lots of hard work, manageable fatigue.
workouts.warmup: 8 min easy row with 3 build-ups.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 3 sets of 10 × (30 s hard / 30 s easy), 3 min rest between sets. Hard means faster than race pace, easy means still rowing.

scaling.up: 4 sets, or 40 s on and 20 s off.

workouts.name: Twenty minute EMOM
workouts.purpose: Forced pacing — the clock decides your rest, so the work has to stay efficient.
workouts.warmup: 8 min easy mixed movement.

blocks.name: EMOM 20
blocks.detail: Minute 1: 15 cal row. Minute 2: 15 wall balls. Minute 3: 15 kettlebell swings. Minute 4: 12 burpees. Repeat five times through.

scaling.down: 12 minutes, drop reps by a third.

workouts.name: Twenty minute AMRAP
workouts.purpose: A repeatable benchmark. Log the rounds and retest in 8 weeks.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, light reps of each movement.

blocks.name: AMRAP 20
blocks.detail: 250 m row, 15 dumbbell thrusters, 10 burpees, 20 m walking lunge. As many rounds as possible in 20 min. Pace it so round 6 matches round 1.

workouts.name: Chipper
workouts.purpose: One long grind through a fixed list — mentally close to a race.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, light reps of everything.

blocks.name: For time
blocks.detail: 1000 m row, 60 wall balls, 800 m ski, 50 kettlebell swings, 600 m run, 40 burpees, 400 m run. Straight through, no planned rest.

scaling.up: Add 100 m farmers carry between each block.

workouts.name: Kettlebell and erg couplet
workouts.purpose: Simple, repeatable, hard. Good for a short midweek engine hit.
workouts.warmup: 5 min easy row, 20 light swings.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 5 rounds: 400 m row + 20 kettlebell swings, 90 s rest. Same row split every round.

workouts.name: Erg threshold blocks
workouts.purpose: Sustained aerobic work without the impact cost of more running.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy row with drills.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 4 × 5 min at threshold, 2 min easy between. Stroke rate 24-26, split within 2 s across all four.

workouts.name: Bike sprints
workouts.purpose: Maximum effort with minimum soreness — useful in heavy running weeks.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy spin with 4 × 10 s build-ups.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 10 × 20 s maximum effort, 100 s easy spin between. Watts should not drop more than 10% from sprint 1 to sprint 10.

workouts.name: Death by burpees
workouts.purpose: A brutal, equipment-free benchmark that fits anywhere.
workouts.warmup: 8 min easy movement, 10 slow burpees.

blocks.name: Main
blocks.detail: Minute 1: 1 burpee. Minute 2: 2 burpees. Continue adding one each minute until you can't finish the round inside the minute. Note the round you reached.

workouts.cooldown: 5 min walk, chest and hip stretch.

scaling.down: Start at 3 and add one every minute.
scaling.up: Start at 5, or use burpee broad jumps.

workouts.name: Tabata mix
workouts.purpose: Short, sharp, and over quickly when time is tight.
workouts.warmup: 8 min easy, light reps.

blocks.name: Four tabatas
blocks.detail: Each is 8 × (20 s hard / 10 s rest), 1 min between tabatas: row for calories, wall balls, air squats, burpees.

scaling.up: Six tabatas, add ski and kettlebell swings.

workouts.name: Descending ladder
workouts.purpose: Work shrinks as fatigue grows, so intensity has to rise.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, light reps.

blocks.name: For time
blocks.detail: 500 m row and 30 wall balls, then 400 m and 25, then 300 m and 20, then 200 m and 15, then 100 m and 10. No rest.

workouts.name: Engine builder
workouts.purpose: An hour of steady mixed-modal work. Boring on purpose, and it builds the base everything else sits on.
workouts.warmup: Built in — start easy.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 6 rounds of 10 min, rotating ski, row, bike. Steady zone 2 the whole way, no stopping between machines. Heart rate should stay under 75% max.

scaling.up: 75 min, add a 1 km run between rounds.

workouts.name: Alternating intervals
workouts.purpose: Switching machines every interval keeps intensity high while local fatigue clears.
workouts.warmup: 300 m easy on each machine.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 12 × 90 s hard, alternating ski and row, 60 s rest. Log the distance for each — the last should be within 5% of the first.

workouts.name: Three eight minute blocks
workouts.purpose: Race-length intensity in repeatable chunks, with enough rest to hit each one hard.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, light reps.

blocks.name: Block 1
blocks.detail: AMRAP 8: 250 m row, 15 wall balls.

blocks.name: Rest
blocks.detail: 4 min complete rest.

blocks.name: Block 2
blocks.detail: AMRAP 8: 20 kettlebell swings, 15 burpees.

blocks.name: Rest
blocks.detail: 4 min complete rest.

blocks.name: Block 3
blocks.detail: AMRAP 8: 400 m run, 20 m walking lunge.

workouts.name: Machine triathlon
workouts.purpose: One continuous effort across all three machines — a fair test of raw engine.
workouts.warmup: 5 min easy on each.

blocks.name: For time
blocks.detail: 2000 m row, 2000 m ski, 5000 m bike, straight through. Even effort, not even pace — the ski will feel hardest.

scaling.up: Repeat the whole thing in reverse after 5 min rest.

workouts.name: Swings and rows
workouts.purpose: Posterior chain conditioning that carries straight into the sled pull.
workouts.warmup: 5 min easy row, 20 light swings.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 6 rounds: 250 m row hard + 15 heavy kettlebell swings, 60 s rest.

workouts.name: Bodyweight only
workouts.purpose: For a hotel room or a travel day, with nothing but floor space.
workouts.warmup: 5 min marching, leg swings, arm circles.

blocks.name: Circuit
blocks.detail: 5 rounds, 90 s rest: 20 air squats, 15 push-ups, 10 burpees, 20 walking lunges, 30 s plank.

workouts.name: Travel dumbbell session
workouts.purpose: One pair of dumbbells, a full-body hit, no machines needed.
workouts.warmup: 5 min skipping or jogging on the spot.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 5 rounds, 2 min rest: 12 dumbbell thrusters, 12 renegade rows, 20 m dumbbell lunge, 10 burpees over the dumbbells.

workouts.name: Five rounds for time
workouts.purpose: A simple benchmark you can retest all year.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy, light reps.

blocks.name: For time
blocks.detail: 5 rounds: 400 m row, 20 wall balls, 10 pull-ups. No planned rest. Log the total and the split per round.

scaling.down: 4 rounds, ring rows instead of pull-ups.

workouts.name: Erg pyramid
workouts.purpose: Changing interval lengths so you never settle into one comfortable rhythm.
workouts.warmup: 8 min easy row.

blocks.name: Pyramid
blocks.detail: 250 m, 500 m, 750 m, 1000 m, 750 m, 500 m, 250 m. Rest equal to half the time of the piece just rowed. Longer pieces at race pace, short ones faster.

workouts.name: Long mixed grind
workouts.purpose: Deliberately long low-intensity mixed work to build durability for race day's back half.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.detail: 6 rounds at a steady, conversational pace: 1 km run, 500 m row, 500 m ski, 50 m sled push at 50% race weight, 100 m farmers carry. Keep heart rate under 80% throughout — if it climbs, slow down.

scaling.up: 8 rounds, or sled at 75% race weight.

workouts.name: Full race simulation
workouts.purpose: The whole thing at race standard. Do this two or three times in a build, no more.
workouts.warmup: 20 min: easy jog building to race pace, light reps at each station, mobility.

blocks.name: Race
blocks.detail: 8 × 1 km runs alternating with: 1000 m ski, 50 m sled push, 50 m sled pull, 80 m burpee broad jumps, 1000 m row, 200 m farmers carry, 100 m sandbag lunges, 100 wall balls. Race weights. Log every split including roxzone time.

workouts.cooldown: 15 min walk, full stretch, refuel within 30 min.

scaling.down: Use 70% station weights and keep the full distances.
scaling.up: Pro weights, or add a weighted vest for the runs.

workouts.name: Negative split sim
workouts.purpose: Full distance with a strict pacing rule — finish faster than you start.
workouts.warmup: 20 min as for a race.

blocks.name: Race
blocks.detail: Full sim, but the first four runs are capped 15 s per km slower than race pace. Runs 5 to 8 must each be faster than the one before. Discipline early is the whole session.

scaling.down: Half sim with the same rule.
scaling.up: Cap the first four runs 20 s slower, then negative split harder.

workouts.name: Front half sim
workouts.purpose: Runs one to four and the first four stations, at full race intensity.
workouts.warmup: 15 min easy jog, light station reps.

blocks.name: Race
blocks.detail: 1 km + 1000 m ski, 1 km + 50 m sled push, 1 km + 50 m sled pull, 1 km + 80 m burpee broad jumps. Race weights, race pace, full transitions.

scaling.down: 70% sled weight, 50 m burpee broad jumps.
scaling.up: Follow with a 2 km time trial.

workouts.name: Back half sim
workouts.purpose: The half most people neglect, trained fresh so you can actually work on it.
workouts.warmup: 15 min easy jog, light station reps.

blocks.name: Race
blocks.detail: 1 km + 1000 m row, 1 km + 200 m farmers carry, 1 km + 100 m sandbag lunges, 1 km + 100 wall balls. Race weights and pace.

scaling.down: 70% weights, halve the carry and lunge distances.
scaling.up: Start with 20 min of steady running to pre-fatigue.

workouts.name: Doubles format solo
workouts.purpose: Half the station volume, full runs — high intensity, lower total damage.
workouts.warmup: 15 min as for a race.

blocks.name: Race
blocks.detail: Full 8 × 1 km runs, but half volume at every station: 500 m ski, 25 m sled push, 25 m pull, 40 m burpee broad jumps, 500 m row, 100 m carry, 50 m lunges, 50 wall balls. Push the runs harder than race pace.

scaling.up: Full station volume on the last two.

workouts.name: Pro weight partial
workouts.purpose: Heavy exposure at short distances, so open weights feel light on race day.
workouts.warmup: 15 min, thorough — the loads are high.

blocks.name: Race
blocks.detail: 4 rounds: 1 km run + one station at pro weight and half distance. Rotate sled push, sled pull, farmers carry, sandbag lunges. Full rest if a set breaks down.

scaling.down: Use open weights at full distance instead.

workouts.name: Broken sim
workouts.purpose: Full race volume split in two, so you can hit race intensity without a full recovery week after.
workouts.warmup: 15 min race warm-up.

blocks.name: Block 1
blocks.detail: Runs 1 to 4 with their stations, at race pace.

blocks.name: Rest
blocks.detail: 10 min complete rest. Eat and drink as you would mid-race if it were legal — practise taking on fuel.

blocks.name: Block 2
blocks.detail: Runs 5 to 8 with their stations, at race pace or faster.

workouts.name: Stations only time trial
workouts.purpose: Strip the runs out and find your true station total, plus how fast you transition.
workouts.warmup: 15 min, light reps everywhere.

blocks.name: Time trial
blocks.detail: All 8 stations in race order, with 200 m shuttle runs between instead of 1 km. Race weights. Time the whole thing and each transition.

scaling.up: No shuttles — straight from one station to the next.

workouts.name: Fuelling rehearsal sim
workouts.purpose: A full sim where the point is testing food, drink and timing rather than chasing a time.
workouts.warmup: 20 min, eating the exact pre-race meal 2-3 hours before.

blocks.name: Race
blocks.detail: Full sim at 90% race effort. Take your planned carbs and fluid at the same points you would in the race. Record what you took, when, and how your stomach handled it.

workouts.cooldown: 15 min walk, then your planned recovery meal within 30 min. Write down what to change.

scaling.down: Half sim, same fuelling plan halved.
scaling.up: Full race effort with the fuelling plan intact.

workouts.name: Race week opener
workouts.purpose: Three to four days out: touch race pace, stay sharp, take nothing out of the legs.
workouts.warmup: 10 min easy jog, mobility.

blocks.name: Opener
blocks.detail: 2 × (400 m run at race pace + 250 m ski + 15 wall balls + 25 m sled push at race weight), 3 min rest between. Everything crisp, nothing near failure.

scaling.up: Three rounds, still stopping well short of hard.

workouts.name: Hips and ankles
workouts.purpose: The two joints that limit squat depth on wall balls and lunges.
workouts.warmup: 5 min easy walk or spin.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.detail: 90/90 hip switches 10 each side. Couch stretch 90 s each. Deep squat hold 3 × 60 s. Ankle knee-to-wall 15 each side. Adductor rock backs 10 each.

workouts.cooldown: 3 min slow breathing in child's pose.

scaling.up: Add loaded holds with a kettlebell.

workouts.name: Thoracic and shoulders
workouts.purpose: Overhead position for ski and wall balls, and undoing a week at a desk.
workouts.warmup: Arm circles, band pull-aparts.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.detail: Foam roll thoracic spine 2 min. Open book 10 each side. Wall slides 3 × 12. Lat stretch on a rack 60 s each. Thread the needle 8 each side.

scaling.down: Skip the foam rolling if it's uncomfortable.
scaling.up: Add hanging from a bar, 3 × 30 s.

workouts.name: Easy spin and stretch
workouts.purpose: Blood flow without impact, the day after something hard.
workouts.warmup: None needed.

blocks.name: Spin
blocks.detail: 25 min very easy, zone 1, nose breathing.

blocks.name: Stretch
blocks.detail: 10 min full lower body: quads, hamstrings, calves, hips, glutes. 45 s each.

workouts.name: Water recovery
workouts.purpose: Zero impact movement that's genuinely restorative after a sim.
workouts.warmup: 5 min easy swimming or walking in the shallow end.

blocks.name: Main
blocks.detail: 20 min easy swimming, or pool walking and light jogging in chest-deep water. Stop well short of breathless.

workouts.cooldown: 5 min floating and stretching against the wall.

scaling.up: 30 min with some easy pull sets.

workouts.name: Long walk
workouts.purpose: The most underrated recovery tool there is, and it costs nothing.
workouts.warmup: None.

blocks.name: Walk
blocks.detail: 45–60 min outdoors at a comfortable pace. No podcast pace-pushing, no hills hunting. Just walk.

workouts.cooldown: 5 min calf and hip stretch when home.

scaling.up: 90 min, or add a light pack.

workouts.name: Flow for athletes
workouts.purpose: Mobility with a breathing element, for the evening after a hard day.
workouts.warmup: 5 min cat-cow and easy movement.

blocks.name: Flow
blocks.detail: Three rounds, moving slowly with the breath: downward dog, low lunge each side, pigeon each side, seated forward fold, supine twist each side. Hold each 45-60 s.

workouts.cooldown: 5 min lying still, breathing out longer than in.

scaling.up: Four rounds, add standing balance poses.

workouts.name: Foam roll protocol
workouts.purpose: Targeted soft tissue work on the areas hybrid training beats up most.
workouts.warmup: 2 min easy movement.

blocks.name: Roll
blocks.detail: 90 s each: quads, IT band area, glutes, hamstrings, calves, lats, thoracic spine. Slow, pausing on tender spots and breathing out.

workouts.cooldown: Light stretch of anything that was sore.

scaling.up: Add a lacrosse ball for feet and glutes.

workouts.name: Breathing downregulation
workouts.purpose: Shift out of training stress and sleep better, especially after evening sessions.
workouts.warmup: None.

blocks.name: Protocol
blocks.detail: 5 min box breathing, 4 s in, 4 s hold, 4 s out, 4 s hold. Then 5 min with exhale twice as long as inhale. Then 5 min lying still doing nothing.

scaling.up: 20 min, add legs up the wall.

workouts.name: Race morning activation
workouts.purpose: Wake the system up on race morning without touching your race energy.
workouts.warmup: None.

blocks.name: Activation
blocks.detail: 5 min easy jog. Leg swings and hip openers. 10 air squats, 10 push-ups, 10 walking lunges. 4 × 15 s strides building to race pace. Then rest.

workouts.cooldown: Stay warm, sit down, sip fluid.

scaling.up: Add 2 × 20 s at faster than race pace.

workouts.name: Deload movement circuit
workouts.purpose: Keep the movement patterns alive during a deload week without adding fatigue.
workouts.warmup: 5 min easy movement.

blocks.name: Circuit
blocks.detail: 3 rounds at roughly 50% effort, resting as needed: 10 goblet squats light, 10 push-ups, 10 dumbbell rows each side, 10 glute bridges, 20 m easy carry, 30 s plank.
